title: AI-Workflow Model Requirements Manifest (authoritative, v2 precedence)
description: SOLE authority for model policy. Precedence: agent/task explicit model → global_agent_model → runtime/session model. model null/absent = inherit (normal, not fallback). Exact model = require exactly; unavailable explicit overrides fail closed. tier_hint is metadata and must not determine execution. No provider provisioning fields allowed.

global_agent_model.description: Optional shared override for all agents/tasks without their own model. null = no global override (inherit runtime/session model). Must be an exact provider/model id when set.

model.description: Exact model identifier provider/model, or null/absent = inherit (continue to global, then runtime/session). Vague tiers (cheap/balanced/frontier/haiku-class) are forbidden here.

provider.description: Explicit provider requirement, or null when inheriting (no explicit provider requirement).

tier_hint.description: Descriptive metadata only. Must not determine execution.

fallbacks.description: Approved substitutes for an EXPLICIT model only, honored in order. Must be [] when inheriting.
